title: Voyager 1 reaches one light day on the abduction anniversary

tellings.quote: In fact, this year, 2026, on November 18th, at 3:16 a.m. Mountain time, exactly 49 years from the time Mario and Michael were blacked out aboard a spacecraft, Voyager 1 will be exactly one full light day away from Earth.

plain: Michels points out that on November 18, 2026, at 3:16 a.m. Mountain time, Voyager 1, NASA's distant space probe, will be exactly one light day from Earth, meaning its signals will take a full day to reach us. He notes that this is exactly 49 years to the minute after two Air Force veterans, Mario and Michael, say they were blacked out aboard a spacecraft. Michels draws the link himself, in an episode reuniting the two men, as a striking coincidence of timing.
